news.title: LGBTQ Americans Stand Out for Being Part of Online Communities, Finding Value in Them
news.summary_en: LGBTQ adults are more likely to join online communities, though some also leave over people being harassed.

news.title: Majorities in Both Parties Say Media Criticism Keeps Politicians in Check
news.summary_en: Overall, 80% of Americans express this view, up from 75% in September 2025. Another 16% say such criticism keeps political leaders from doing their job.

news.title: Americans’ Trust in Information From News Organizations Has Risen in the Past Year
news.summary_en: Trust in national and local news has risen since last year across parties and age groups, while trust in social media is virtually unchanged.

news.title: How Many People in the U.S. Are Middle Eastern or North African?
news.summary_en: Estimates of the U.S. Middle Eastern or North African population range from 3.1 to 5.2 million in 2024, depending on how ancestry, race and language are counted.
